column1: # Book 2 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. Opus gloss findings adjudicated:
# 2.23 requirit absolute: nature does not feel the want (of the statues etc.); "require" left the verb objectless.
# 2.94 pluribus ostendi governs patere: "as I have shown" so the sentence parses.

column2: more welcome now and then; nor does nature herself feel the want,
as I have shown in many words and proved by sure reasoning.
